title: Align panel icons clip outside their buttons / render unclear
description:
FIXED. Replaced the crude overflowing ASCII 'icon' labels in AlignPanel.tsx with 16 crisp inline-SVG align/distribute/match-size/space glyphs (16x16 viewBox, centered) and corrected the button box sizing so icons fit cleanly inside the 26x22 buttons.

Root-cause fix (both halves of the MIXED verdict):
- AlignButton now renders an SVG icon node instead of a multi-char ASCII 'label' string (fixes the long-standing unclear/low-quality glyphs from commit 4b4e4cf).
- AlignButton style now overrides buttonStyle's 'padding:2px 8px' with padding:0, adds boxSizing:'border-box' and overflow:'hidden', and sets color:halo.iconColor. The 8px side padding was the Wave B re-theme regression (commit 4b234215) that left only ~10px usable width and clipped 3-4 char labels; with padding:0 + box-sizing the 16px icon centers in the 26x22 box with margin to spare.
- Icons use halo.iconColor (#2B333C) for object bars and halo.haloBlue (#009DFF) for the alignment-guide reference line, per docs/30-flash8-ui-spec.md System B (light Halo theme tokens retained; no hardcoded hex except the spec accent which is the token value).

VERIFY (commands + results):
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build -> Done (all 7 packages, tsc clean; would flag the now-unused 'chrome' usage / type errors).
- pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run -> Test Files 44 passed (44), Tests 653 passed (653). Zero failures (better than the ~3 task-1207 fixture allowance).
- Screenshot oracle: rendered the exact AlignButton box (buttonStyle('up') + the new overrides) with all 16 SVG icons in headless chromium @3x DPR, each button outlined to its 26x22 border. Confirmed firsthand: every icon sits fully inside its button, no clipping/overflow. (Full app/Ruffle e2e not needed — the bug is pure CSS/SVG layout.)
